refutes.claim: The change does not fix the crash in the repro. The repro's `Item<T>` and `Cmd` put `[Key]` on every member, so neither patched diagnostic (BothStringAndIntKeyAreNull, MemberNeedsKey) is ever created for them; those two sites cannot be what throws. When `reportDiagnostic` is null, `this.reportDiagnostic?.Invoke(...)` skips evaluating its arguments, so any indexing inside those calls never runs. The first unguarded `DeclaringSyntaxReferences[0]` the reporter named (issue line 735, about base line 711 given the consistent 24-line offset to the two patched sites) has no hunk. The `ReportIfLocatedInCompilation` wrapper filters diagnostics only after `Diagnostic.Create`'s arguments have run, so it cannot stop an index exception. A closed generic struct or record struct from a metadata reference most likely still throws IndexOutOfRangeException in the generator (CS8785, no resolver) and the analyzer (AD0001).
